format.about: Recorded Anthropic API responses for one live run of scripts/run_extraction_evals.py (ADR 0041). CI replays them with no API key. Regenerate with --repeat 5 --record; never edit by hand.
format.calls[]: One outbound AsyncMessages.create call, in call order.
format.calls[].request_sha256: SHA-256 of the whole request: model, max_tokens, temperature, system, messages.
format.calls[].system_sha256: The system prompt, by hash only.
format.calls[].user: The last user message, for review. Synthetic criteria only.
format.calls[].response: The response's text, stop reason and token usage.
